question: A cone has a base radius of 6 cm and height of 8 cm. Find its volume (Take pi = 3.14).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of cone = (1 ÷ 3) × π × r² × h

⇒ = (1 ÷ 3) × 3.14 × 6² × 8

⇒ 6² = 36 ⇒ 36 × 8 = 288

⇒ = (1 ÷ 3) × 3.14 × 288 = 3.14 × 96

⇒ = 301.44 cm³

**∴ Answer = 301.44 cm³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = 6 cm

Height (h) = 8 cm

π = 3.14

**Formula:**

Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × π × r² × h

 
• 
• 
• h = 8 r = 6 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × 3.14 × 6² × 8

⇒ = (1 ÷ 3) × 3.14 × 36 × 8

⇒ = (1 ÷ 3) × 3.14 × 288

⇒ = 3.14 × 96 = 301.44 cm³

**∴ Volume of cone = 301.44 cm³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Cone Volume:** V = (1 ÷ 3) × π × r² × h

**Cylinder Volume:** V = π × r² × h

**Relation:** Cone volume is 1 ÷ 3 of cylinder (same base & height)

**Slant Height:** l = √(r² + h²)
